fields: Rascal ducks down under the counter…
Maaaaavieeee~! We’ve got some <wiggle a=0.075 f=2.5>shmekels</wiggle> for ya!
Just a couple things! Some claw clippers, floss, a spatula, cooking oil-
No, something’s up… I can <speed=0.25>smell it… <waitfor=0.5><speed=1>Is Rascal here?
Right before you guys came in! I keep telling him he’s gotta take a shower! <color=#838383>He’s a really stinky pan-!</color>
*Next scene where rascal is sucking him off*
<speed=0.25>And this… <wave a=0.1 f=3>“shlucking”</wave> sound I’m hearing…?
<speed=0.1>Uh… <speed=1>O-old pipes y’know… <waitfor=0.5>Sprung a leak in the back… <waitfor=0.5>it’s a… <waitfor=0.5><size=10><color=#838383>mmmnggg…</color> <size=16>It’s a mess…
*Next illustration, rascal face full of dong*
And this new smell… Like… hmm… <waitfor=0.5>Help me out here Claire…
<speed=0.25>Well . . . <waitfor=0.5><speed=0.75>I guess in that case I’ll carry on with my order.
Let’s remove the last things on the list.
Now I’m just looking for something <size=18><speed=0.25>thick and hard . . .
Ok that’s it, I’m going back there.
N-no! This area is employees only!
I see we just missed the show…
Oh he can go again. Maverick’s a marathon man.
No, no, everyone out of the counter. I have to clean this up before anyone else—
My back’s been acting up again… I was wondering if ya had any of those herbs?
… I’m gonna keep messing with him…
Oh don’t worry, Bucky’s kinda hard of hearing. If we keep our voice down—
Maverick, thats my bad ear, speak at this one!
The herbs, yes they are just over—
*animate up the hand with the herbs, like, slide it upward over a second or two.
<color=#838383>You think you can just get a free show?
Wow did you just… <waitfor=0.75>cum from making a sale?
That’s such a big step for you! I told ya it makes the work day better!
Ok, so what do I owe ya for all this?
Well great! I’m going to leave before you change your mind!
Also heh… <waitfor=0.5>I like your new tails!
Maverick looks under the counter to see a mess of critters and spunk. The coyotes are hungrily lapping away at Rascal.
OK LADIES. If you want to be employees so badly, you must pass the interview!
But I didn’t bring my resume!
Rascal, you’re being promoted to Manager’s Assistant.
I need your help with the routine cookie inspection!
Maybe attached to a pair of big <waitfor=0.5><size=18>fluffy <waitfor=0.5><size=24>NUTS-
No, I need a new ice pack… my previous one sprung a leak and…
Oh no, Claire… <shake a=0.3>we haven’t shaved…</shake>
